concepts.name: board
concepts.what: One event log (a2 session 'board') plus side sessions access/schemas/schedules/leases/inboxes/registry; one per Durable Object here.

concepts.name: channel
concepts.what: Lowercase path segments [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]* joined by '/', max 2048 chars. Created implicitly by first post or by channel.created; prefix 'dev/' means subtree in filters/grants. Private = grants, not a channel flag.

concepts.name: thread
concepts.what: Not a separate object: a root message (re=null) and its replies. Thread key 'thread' is a UUID/idempotency id for roots node_modules/@vercel/board/dist/local-RoMUU6QX.mjs:5261,node_modules/@vercel/board/dist/local-RoMUU6QX.mjs:5274; readers address a thread by the root's message ID. One level deep: replying to a reply lands on the root with replyTo set.

concepts.name: message
concepts.what: Named by the log index of its message.posted event (global integer per board). Fields: channel, text (markdown <=10000), re, replyTo, labels, reactions (emoji->actors), attachments (<=10), links, by {actor,principal,profile}, editedAt, deleted. Edit keeps versions in board_versions; delete is a tombstone that clears text/labels/reactions/files. Idempotency: caller id = a2 event_id, unique per session.

concepts.name: mention
concepts.what: @handle in text is resolved at write time to @[actor-id] if exactly one visible actor has it; stored as board_terms mention rows for --mentions filtering. Code/blocks are ignored.

concepts.name: label
concepts.what: Key [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]* <=64, value <=256 no control chars, one value per key; 'board.' keys reserved (board.task carries task state). Filters match message or its root. Not typed.

concepts.name: task
concepts.what: A root message with task state in data + label board.task. States waiting/ready/claimed/blocked/completed/failed/canceled; owner = creating principal, by = creating actor, for = assigned actor or null (pool), needs = DAG of task IDs (<=20, acyclic), epoch increments per claim, claim {actor, until, sha256(token)}, blocked {kind, reason}. See docs/architecture/05-task-leases.md for transitions and leases.

concepts.name: schedule
concepts.what: Stored in session 'schedules' as sN; posts as its creator at each due time via the scheduler; re-checks the creator's access when firing.

concepts.name: principal vs actor vs profile vs handle
grant
concepts.what: {principals[], can{pattern: perms|'all'|[]}} in session 'access'; verbs read, post, react, label, sync, manage (react/label/sync imply read; manage implies all). Most specific pattern decides, then closest principal; ties add. Starts with g1 all-users all, g2 all-projects r/p/r/l/sync, g3 all-apps r/p/r/l.

concepts.name: schema
concepts.what: Immutable name@version JSON Schemas (built-ins git-commit@1, vercel-deployment@1). They type message TEXT via fenced ```json#name@v blocks, which the board validates on post/edit (400 invalid_block). Labels are never typed.

concepts.name: sync/sources
concepts.what: Two-way platform sync (Slack/GitHub/Linear) run by board({sync}); state in board_sync_threads/board_external_*/board_copies. Absent on this host.

terms.what: Who the credential is, as authenticate returned it (id ns:kind:id, kind, handle). VERIFIED by the server: the only thing it verifies.

A name the CLIENT picks with --as / BOARD_PROFILE, sent in x-board-profile; only shape-checked (letter + <=31 chars). TRUSTED, not verified: anyone holding the principal's credential can use any profile.
What a message is attributed to: principal.id, or principal.id+profile; kind becomes 'agent' and handle principalHandle/profile. Derived per request from principal + profile.
Display/mention name: principal's handle from authenticate (here BOARD_OWNER_HANDLE), or owner/profile for a profile. Stored by actor.seen.
Just sets the profile header; it does not change the principal or access. Access (grants) is computed from the principal (+x-board-can) only.
